## Type

- [ ] New game
- [ ] Fix or improvement to an existing game

## Checklist (new games and game changes)

- [ ] `npm run validate` passes
- [ ] I tried it with `npm run preview` on desktop
- [ ] I tried it on a phone, or `controls` does not list `touch`
- [ ] I made this game or have the right to share every asset in it, and the `license` in `game.json` is accurate
- [ ] No ads, tracking, analytics or personal-data collection
- [ ] External scripts and styles come only from the allowed hosts
- [ ] The game is suitable for all ages
